The card itself and the automatic details are right. Before you move on, though, a few things about this saving flow that I'd want to feel complete:

- **Opening it again.** When I come back later and click one of these saved cards, I'd expect it to take me straight to the original page. Right now I'm not sure tapping the card actually does that.
- **Fixing what got fetched.** The auto-filled title and description are usually great, but sometimes they're long or not quite how I'd describe it. I'd want to be able to tweak the title or description — both right after saving and later on.
- **Not saving the same thing twice.** If I paste a link I've already saved, I don't want a second copy to pile up. I'd expect it to just bring me back to the one I already have so I can edit that, rather than making a duplicate.

Those three feel like part of "saving and showing a link" to me, so I'd like them included before we call this flow done. Everything else here matches my intent.
